description.zh: 截图、标注、贴图、长截图、识别文字、录屏和演示白板
description.en: Screenshots, annotations, pins, long screenshots, text recognition, screen recording and a presentation whiteboard

notes.zh: 贴图里的字可以直接选：贴图出来后在后台自动识别图里的字，鼠标移到字上按住拖动就选中，`Ctrl+C` 或 `T` 复制，`Ctrl+A` 全选；拖空白处或按住 `Alt` 拖仍是移动贴图（截图设置 › 贴图 › 贴图后自动识别文字，默认开）。贴图上按 `Shift+C` 或右键“复制全部文字”，复制图里所有的字（#423）。截图编辑时按 `Esc` 先放下工具、取消选中，再按才放弃标注或关闭；文字框在编辑时、文字工具开着时都能直接拖（#415）。文字识别气泡的标题、背景和关闭按钮和其他窗口一致。权限不变。
notes.en: Select the words in a pin: they are read in the background, so a drag over them selects and `Ctrl+C` or `T` copies, `Ctrl+A` selects all; dragging blank space or with `Alt` held still moves the pin (capture settings › Pin › 贴图后自动识别文字, on by default). `Shift+C` on a pin, or Copy all text in its menu, copies every word in it (#423). In the editor `Esc` puts a tool down and deselects first, and only then drops the annotations or closes; text boxes can be dragged while being edited and while the text tool is on (#415). The OCR bubble's heading, surface and close button match the other windows. Permissions unchanged.
